12: A Bar Mitzvah - It happens when a boy becomes 13 years and one day old. Now it is customary to bless when the young man leads prayers or reads Torah on shabbat for the first time, because then it is known publicly that he is bar mitzvah (Lechem Hamudot). Yalkut Hadash says that a person is commanded to make a feast on the day his son becomes a bar mitzvah, like the day he gets married. It is obvious that it happens when a boy enters his 14th year. In Yam Shel Shlomo, chapter 7 of Bava Kamma it says that if the young man gives a dvar torah it is a seudat mitzvah even if it doesn't happen on the day [that he turns 13 and one day].

From this punishment - The explanation is that until now the father was punished when the son sinned because he did not educate his son. The Levush explains the opposite - until now the son was punished for the father's sins. See there.
